mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topics) AS topic_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_sessions) AS session_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_feedbacks WHERE status = '待处理') AS pending_feedback_count

SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.login_name, u.nickname, u.school, u.major, u.bio, u.role, DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id) AS session_count FROM users u
AND ( u.login_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' )
ORDER BY u.user_id
SELECT role FROM users WHERE user_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, school = #{school}, major = #{major}, bio = #{bio}, role = #{role} WHERE user_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS id, category_name AS name, sort_order FROM categories ORDER BY sort_order, category_id
SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE category_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (category_name, sort_order) SELECT #{name}, COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM categories
mapper.select: SELECT t.topic_id AS id, t.category_id, c.category_name, t.title, t.difficulty, t.duration_min, t.duration_max, t.guide_text AS guide, t.is_recommended AS recommended, t.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_checkpoints k WHERE k.topic_id = t.topic_id) AS checkpoint_count FROM topics t INNER JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = t.category_id ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.topic_id

SELECT t.topic_id AS id, t.category_id, c.category_name, t.title, t.difficulty, t.duration_min, t.duration_max, t.guide_text AS guide, t.is_recommended AS recommended, t.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_checkpoints k WHERE k.topic_id = t.topic_id) AS checkpoint_count FROM topics t INNER JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = t.category_id WHERE t.topic_id = #{id}
SELECT label, keywords FROM topic_checkpoints WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY sort_order, checkpoint_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_sessions WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.update: UPDATE topics SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, duration_max = #{durationMax}, guide_text = #{guide}, is_recommended = #{recommended}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE topic_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_checkpoints (topic_id, label, keywords, sort_order) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{label}, #{keywords}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id AS id, u.login_name, u.nickname, s.topic_id, t.title, s.status, DATE_FORMAT(s.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS started_at, DATE_FORMAT(s.ended_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS ended_at, s.duration_seconds, s.fail_reason, r.report_id, r.total_score AS score, r.speech_rate, r.pause_count, r.fluency_score AS fluency, r.content_score, r.transcript, r.content_summary, r.result_label, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_audios a WHERE a.session_id = s.session_id) AS has_audio FROM training_sessions s INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id INNER JOIN topics t ON t.topic_id = s.topic_id LEFT JOIN analysis_reports r ON r.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.session_id = #{id}

SELECT f.feedback_id AS id, u.login_name, u.nickname, f.category, f.content, f.status, DATE_FORMAT(f.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at, f.reply_content AS reply, DATE_FORMAT(f.replied_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS replied_at FROM user_feedbacks f INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.feedback_id = #{id}
